comment: Hand-kept corrections to the citations parse-ref-spans.ts cannot carry on its own (spec-books §8). `at` is chapter.paragraph, or chapter.eN for a section's Nth epigraph; `text` must still match its atom exactly once or the build fails. `note` is documentation only.

fix.note: The one citation Murray sets in arabic chapter:verse instead of his usual roman.
Second half of the same arabic-style bracket.
Transcribed numeral gained an x: Matthew has no chapter 33, and the quotation is Matt. 23:11.
The verse list lost its comma to a period, so the scanner reaches only verse 9.
